main.changelog:
26.32.04:

Features & Enhancements:
- UI & Localization: Added language download window, localization support, and show language author in download list.
- UI Enhancements: Added simple UI scaling.
- Configuration UI: Added input text fields for Max Force, Min Travel, etc.
- Hardware Integration: Added predictive voltage-based brake resistor support for PCBAs.
- Physics / Dynamics: Position-based effect update and added pedal dynamics to rudder.
- Connectivity: Added wireless config support.
- LED & Safety: Added homing timeout and PedalLED class.
- Geometry & Curves: Force curve and pedal geometry changes.
- Build System: Auto-update pluginVersion during build.

Bug Fixes & Stability:
- Wireless/ESPNOW: Fix ESPNOW random hanging issues and connection stability.
- Hardware/Motor: Reduce velocity loop gain to minimize noise.
- Safety: Limit soft endstop dynamic expansion.
- Calculations: Prevent curve calculation errors.
- UI Adjustments: Fix layout shifting and trigger mapping.
- Hardware Timing: Removed delays after endstop hit, added WDT resets.
- Data Integrity: Defer EEPROM writes until motor idle.
- Other Fixes: Fix serial-port index bug, rudder config clearing, LED brightness, crash detection.

Refactoring & Cleanup:
- Refactored USB HID, ESPNOW_lib.h, Main.cpp, and LED usage.
- Code optimization and aligned naming with guidelines.

Maintenance & Version Bumps:
- Bumped firmware to 26.30.07 and updated payload config versions.
- Removed dev/test build options in the update window.
